FeatureCollect: Share a form and gather submissions from many people, each saved as a separate copy.
FeatureExport: Download collected data or connect it to your systems for further processing.
FeatureForms: Turn PDF documents into interactive forms that others can fill out online.
FeatureGallery: Pick a ready-made form from the template gallery instead of building one from scratch.
FormsCreate: Collect forms in a new room or start from a ready-made template in the gallery.
FormsFilter: Narrow the list by tags, owner, or other parameters.
FormsInfoPanel: Open the info panel to view form details, manage access, and track activity.
FormsIntro: This is the Forms section — create PDF forms, share them, and collect responses in dedicated rooms.
FormsQuickAccess: Recent forms, favorites, templates, and Trash are always at hand right under Forms.
FormsSearch: Quickly find the form you need by name.
FormsTemplates: Browse ready-made form templates and create a new form in one click.
FormsView: Switch between the row and tile views — choose whichever is more convenient for you.
